resources.string: Build a bridge together before the water rises.
You and 1 to 3 friendly helper robots build one bridge together. Each of you has a lane.
Two to four people build one bridge on the same screen, each in their own lane. Helper robots can fill empty lanes.
How many planks the bridge needs, how big the green spots are and how fast the water rises.
A short bridge, wide green spots and slow water: great for the youngest builders.
A good mix for most families.
A long bridge, small green spots and quick water for practised builders.
Every tap places a plank, even outside the green spot, and the cart and the water are slower. Tapping nearer the middle still makes a sturdier plank.
Give one builder a wider green spot so different ages can build side by side.
Robots build a lane of their own, so a small team always has enough builders.
